themes_detail.label: Rodent infestation surge
themes_detail.summary: Rodent complaints spiked to 8 this week versus a baseline of 1.2 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 540% increase (z-score: 6.19)—signaling a potential citywide or district-specific infestation outbreak that demands immediate pest control investigation.
evidence: 8 rodent complaints filed this week vs. 1.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (540% spike)
Z-score of 6.19 indicates statistically significant anomaly (threshold: 2.0)
Spike correlates with unsanitary condition complaints (31 filed 3 weeks ago vs 11.5 avg, suggesting environmental conditions enabling infestation)
reporting_angles: Interview HPD or DSNY about whether this district is a hotspot; are there nearby waste facilities or construction sites disrupting rat populations?
Canvass affected residents to identify geographic clusters and common building conditions (basement access, trash management, age of building)

themes_detail.label: Overgrown trees and branches hazard
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints jumped to 12 this week from a baseline of 4.9 per week—a 146% increase (z-score: 6.11)—indicating potential safety and infrastructure risks that align with longstanding Parks budget requests for maintenance.
evidence: 12 overgrown tree/branch complaints this week vs. 4.9 weekly average (146% increase)
District has repeatedly requested 'provide better park maintenance' and 'reconstruct or upgrade parks' in annual budget submissions—unresolved multi-year gap
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Department to determine if this is seasonal (fall/winter growth) or reflects understaffing; compare maintenance crew allocation to other Queens CDs
Document specific locations with photos; check if any complaints mention proximity to power lines, sidewalks, or building damage

themes_detail.label: Encampment emergence
themes_detail.summary: Encampment complaints hit 4 this week versus 0.6 per week baseline—a 540% spike (z-score: 4.85)—suggesting a sudden rise in homelessness or unsheltered populations in this district over the past 7 days.
evidence: 4 encampment complaints filed this week vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (540% spike)
Z-score of 4.85 indicates high statistical significance
Concurrent spike in unsanitary condition complaints (31 three weeks ago) and illegal dumping complaints (41 last week, 160% above baseline) suggest linked environmental degradation
reporting_angles: Identify specific locations of the 4 reported encampments; interview DHS, NYPD, and local council member about whether this reflects a new shelter closure, transit hub migration, or housing crisis pressure
Talk to encampment residents about what drew them to this district and what barriers prevent shelter access

themes_detail.label: Illegal dumping spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal dumping complaints surged to 41 last week from a baseline of 15.8 per week—a 160% increase (z-score: 3.96)—indicating potential environmental crime and blight that requires DSNY or NYPD investigation and cleanup.
evidence: 41 illegal dumping complaints last week vs. 15.8 weekly average (160% spike)
Overlaps with unsanitary condition spike (31 complaints 3 weeks ago, 170% above baseline) and encampment complaints, suggesting correlated public space deterioration
reporting_angles: Map the 41 dumping locations to identify if they cluster around a specific neighborhood, property, or transit corridor; check for correlation with active development sites
Interview DSNY about enforcement response time and whether fines/prosecutions are being pursued; ask if this is tied to nearby construction or demolition permits (676 filed in last 90 days)

themes_detail.label: Asbestos reports tripled
themes_detail.summary: Asbestos complaints hit 3 last week versus 0.2 per week baseline—a 1100% increase (z-score: 4.16)—indicating potential building code violations or environmental hazard discoveries that require DOB investigation and public health follow-up.
evidence: 3 asbestos complaints last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike)
Z-score of 4.16 indicates high statistical significance
676 building alteration permits filed in last 90 days; 459 are alterations (may involve asbestos disturbance during renovations)
reporting_angles: Identify the 3 buildings with asbestos reports; check DOB violation database for prior citations and whether complaints were tied to active renovation permits
Interview NYC Department of Environmental Protection and building owners about containment procedures and tenant notification; determine if this reflects deferred maintenance or contractor negligence
